finding: After table-build and cache-miss overhead are removed, alternating among already-built authorities remains about five times more expensive than provider-local same-key reuse.
interpretation: The remaining cost is on the warm authority-switch path: exact-key registry lookup plus provider representation transfer/rebinding. F-AHL33 does not establish which subcomponent dominates.
next_action: After F-AHL32 registry qualification closes, decompose warm multi-key switching into registry lookup, table transfer/copy, and analytical fallback rebinding before changing representation ownership.
nonclaims: No application-level slowdown is inferred from this bind microbenchmark.
No pointer or handle ownership repair is admitted by F-AHL33.
